in_hebrew.name: Gewirtz
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gewirtz הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'georgos', meaning 'farmer' or 'earth-worker'. The suffix '-wtz' may indicate 'guardian of' or 'protector'. Thus, Gewirtz could mean 'Jewel guardian' or 'Protector of the Earth'.

in_greek.name: Gewirtz
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Jewel guardian
in_greek.long_meaning: Gewirtz είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek word 'georgos', meaning 'farmer' or 'earth-worker'. The suffix '-wtz' may indicate 'guardian of' or 'protector'. Thus, Gewirtz could mean 'Jewel guardian' or 'Protector of the Earth'.

in_latin.name: Gewirtz
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Jewel guardian
in_latin.long_meaning: Gewirtz est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek word 'georgos', meaning 'farmer' or 'earth-worker'. The suffix '-wtz' may indicate 'guardian of' or 'protector'. Thus, Gewirtz could mean 'Jewel guardian' or 'Protector of the Earth'.
